query:
SELECT cc.nome, cc.classificacao, SUM(lc.valor) as total
FROM lancamento_custo lc
INNER JOIN conta_custo cc ON lc.contaCustoId = cc.id
WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = 60001
GROUP BY cc.nome, cc.classificacao
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 15;
